content_metadata.description: A video lesson where an instructor explains how to name binary ionic compounds, including compounds with polyatomic ions.

qAndA.answer: Binary compounds are ionic compounds that have two elements.
qAndA.question: What are binary compounds?

qAndA.answer: The ion with the positive charge is placed first.
qAndA.question: Which ion is placed first when naming an ionic compound?
What suffix is added to the end of the negatively charged ion?

qAndA.answer: No, polyatomic ions are written as they are named.
qAndA.question: Should you change the ending of a polyatomic ion to -ide?
What is the name of the compound CaCl₂?
